rows.remaining: The probe verifies state-statistics output, a serialized tool allocation-state blob, tool status, mutable DRED settings, and zero-fault DRED data output across DRED 1.0–1.2 interfaces. Populated fault breadcrumb/page-fault output, debugger callbacks, pageable allocation tools, cache diagnostics, and cross-process corruption/restart evidence remain open.

Debug1 through Debug6 enablement and state transitions plus bounded debug-device, command-queue, and command-list resource-state assertions are behavior-backed compatibility controls. GPU-based validation instrumentation and live DRED data remain open.

The sharing contract provider validates same-device resource presentation bookkeeping, fence signaling, and capturable-work GUID lifetime. Window-backed presentation, cross-process capture delivery, and complete sharing-contract integration remain open.
The provider covers TrackWrite and exact CPU-backed upload-buffer visibility. Non-normalized samplers, texture/manual-write combinations, and write-watch tooling remain open.

InfoQueue1 callback registration, storage-filter suppression, ignore-filter delivery, and unregister lifecycle are covered. Cross-thread callback ordering, device-debug event sources, and complete DRED/tool callback integration remain open.
The DSR factory ABI and invalid-device output initialization are covered, but no DSR device IID or scaling execution provider is present; DSR is not advertised.
